verdict.rationale: Luma documents transferring cinematic camera moves from a source video to new scenes, worlds and styles (luma-docs-32, luma-docs-9), so creators can dictate camera motion by reference rather than accept the model's choice. There is no evidence of explicit named camera controls such as pan, zoom, orbit or static presets. Multi-keyframe control governs content changes, not camera paths, so it earns no credit here. The community comment about limited motion is older and generic, so it does not concretely contradict the camera-transfer claim. Missing for 10: explicit pan/zoom/orbit/static camera controls or prompt syntax, any way to direct camera moves without a source video, API or UI documentation detailing camera control, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
